thread:
amelia: just pushed a tiny Next + LlamaIndex starter to github.com/redwood/sample-next-llama-lite. It's aimed at quick eval onboarding but the CI job for edge runtime is failing with auth/retry oddities, can anyone help?

sam: paste the failing log?

amelia: Error: 401 Unauthorized - missing api key. stack points to /node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/fetch.js. retried 0 times.

ashwin: likely env mixup. Are you using NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_API_KEY in server code? Edge/SSR only get server envs if named without NEXT_PUBLIC.

amelia: ugh yes I used NEXT_PUBLIC to make demo easier.

maria: that's the cause. Swap to REDWOOD_API_KEY for server routes and add Authorization header in edge handlers: Authorization: Bearer <KEY>. Also note Vercel edge doesn't expose all envs to middleware.

sam: small SDK-parity note: JS SDK auto-retries generate requests by default for idempotent calls; Python SDK currently does not. Add a short README note so cross-lang samples behave the same.

devex-bot: suggestion: include a tiny retry helper in the sample and a streaming example. e.g. const client = new RedwoodClient({ retry: { retries: 2, backoff: 150 } }); and for await (const chunk of client.streamGenerate(...)) { forward(chunk) }.

amelia: I'll hotfix the env usage, add the retry helper and a README section about server vs client keys and edge caveats. I'll also add a failing test that reproduces the missing-key error.

ci-bot: Build started for branch fix/llama-lite-env-2750011222 — tests queued.

maria: once fixed, can we add a one-liner in the console quickstart guiding users to pick "lite" when they want minimal eval-only samples vs "full" when they need streaming/features? Cuts confusion.

amelia: will do, thanks!
